source: Math grade 3, chapter 2, lesson «ارزش مکانی» (book pp. 31–33). Card MATH-07 (source docx v1 + detailed card): v1 warehouse PLACE_VALUE_ROOM, four columns هزارگان/صدگان/دهگان/یکان, drag + snap, wrong = a token in the wrong column → the weighing machine does not balance; PV-M01 a digit's value confused with the token, PV-M02 columns read from the wrong side; H1 «هر ستون جای مخصوص خودش را دارد.», H2 a visual label on each column, H3 a sample token moves to its place; asset Place Value Board. v2 quest «دستگاه شمارش کارگاه رقم‌های یک شمارهٔ مهم را جابه‌جا کرده است», NUMBER_CONTROL_PANEL, digit drag-drop snapping on four columns, select digit → place → show the value of the place, wrong = Value Preview warns the target is not built, misconception MATH_PV_DIGIT_FACE_VALUE; H1 «هر ستون چه ارزشی دارد؟», H2 pictorial column symbols, H3 one digit placed as an example; assets PROP_PLACE_VALUE_PANEL, PROP_DIGIT_TILE, PROP_VALUE_BEAM; animations digit_snap, column_light, value_expand; sound slot click + rising tone as the value grows; UI four columns + Number Preview; analytics digit_selected, place_selected, placement_error, value_preview, solved; mastery: build several four-digit numbers + «ارزش این رقم چیست؟» in the transfer; transfer: a number on a shipment label, the value of a marked digit. Textbook p.31: bundles 1000/100/10/1 → table → digits; «یکان ۴، دهگان ۵، صدگان صفر، هزارگان ۷» → ۷۰۵۴; p.33: ۵۳۲۱ = ۱ یکی، ۲ ده‌تایی، ۳ صدتایی، ۵ هزارتایی; ۴۰۳۰ = ۴ هزارتایی و ۳ ده‌تایی; expanded forms (۵+۲۰۰+۸۰۰۰=۸۲۰۵).

misconceptions.description: Puts digits in columns as if a digit were worth its face whatever its place (card v2: the value of a digit is taken as independent of its place; v1: value confused with the token).
Keeps the other digits in order but moves the zero, as if an empty place did not need holding (textbook p.31: ۷۰۵۴, «صدگان صفر»).
Answers the marked digit's value with the digit itself (۳ for the ۳ of ۴۰۳۰).
Builds the exact mirror order — reads the columns from the wrong side (card v1 PV-M02; a real risk for children who read Persian right-to-left while numbers are written thousands-first).
Gives the marked digit the value of the mirror column (۳۰۰ for the ۳ of ۴۰۳۰).

procedure_errors.note: pulling the weigh lever with an empty column: the lever stops half-way, the empty columns blink amber and NEO says every column takes a digit — an empty place is a zero. Counts as a wrong attempt for hints; not a misconception.

design_mitigations.note: all tiles look the same; only the column gives a digit its value — the moment a tile snaps, its readout window shows the column value (value_expand: ۵ in دهگان reads ۵۰) and that many crates of the column's size drop onto the right pan, so the value is concrete before any weighing.

the panel is ordered like the textbook table (هزارگان left … یکان right); the pans' stacks keep the same left → right order and the thousand-crates are the biggest, so a mirrored build puts big crates where small ones belong.

mastery.note: card: L1 sees a number built, L2 builds with H1/H2, L3 builds the practice number (with a zero) alone, L4 answers «ارزش این رقم چیست؟» on two shipment labels without hints. L5 needs the later market transfer (plan 04: market counter).

audio.on_snap: SFX_SLOT_CLICK (mechanical slot click) + a rising tone whose pitch follows the column value (card: rising tone as the value grows)
audio.on_wrong: the beam leans, amber blink on the wrong columns, soft flicker
audio.on_solve: luma_motif_3_note_ascending; bell when the panel lamps come on

stages.objective_fa: عدد موجودی انبار را روی صفحه بساز و اهرم ترازو را بکش.

hints.animation: LUMI flies along the four columns left → right; each column lamp blinks in turn while the matching stack on the left pan (thousand-crates, hundred-crates, ten-crates, blocks) pulses (card v2 H1: «هر ستون چه ارزشی دارد؟»; v1 H1: every column has its own place)

the blank name plates light up with the column names هزارگان / صدگان / دهگان / یکان and a small picture of the column's crate (card v2 H2: pictorial symbols on the columns; v1 H2: a visual label on each column); they stay for the rest of the stage

one tile rises from the tray (or from a wrong column) and flies to its right column, snaps and locks with a brass clip (card v1 H3: a sample token moves to its place; v2 H3: one digit placed as an example)

answer_assist.note: tiles in wrong columns go back to the tray, the right ones lock with a brass clip; with none right one example tile is placed and locked

stages.source_note: textbook p.31 activity: bundles of 1000/100/10/1 are put in the table and written as a number — here the left pan holds the stock as 2 thousand-crates, 3 hundred-crates, 5 ten-crates and 4 blocks (MATH-06 crates) and the child builds ۲۳۵۴. Mirror build ۴۵۳۲ = PV-M02.

stages.objective_fa: یکان ۴، دهگان ۵، صدگان صفر، هزارگان ۷ — عدد را بساز.

hints.animation: LUMI flies along the four columns left → right; each column lamp blinks in turn while the matching stack on the left pan (thousand-crates, hundred-crates, ten-crates, blocks) pulses (card v2 H1: «هر ستون چه ارزشی دارد؟»; v1 H1: every column has its own place)

the blank name plates light up with the column names هزارگان / صدگان / دهگان / یکان and a small picture of the column's crate (card v2 H2: pictorial symbols on the columns; v1 H2: a visual label on each column); they stay for the rest of the stage

one tile rises from the tray (or from a wrong column) and flies to its right column, snaps and locks with a brass clip (card v1 H3: a sample token moves to its place; v2 H3: one digit placed as an example)

answer_assist.note: tiles in wrong columns go back to the tray, the right ones lock with a brass clip; with none right one example tile is placed and locked

stages.source_note: textbook p.31 Q3 verbatim: «رقم یکان ۴، دهگان ۵، صدگان صفر، هزارگان ۷» → ۷۰۵۴ «هفت هزار و پنجاه و چهار». The left pan has no hundred-crates — the zero holds the place. ۷۵۴۰ / ۷۵۰۴ = zero_misplaced, ۴۵۰۷ = reversed.

hints.animation: LUMI circles the lit digit on the shipment label; four small column ticks appear under the label's digits
the label's four digits fly into the panel's columns (the column names show); the lit digit's column glows
value_expand on the lit digit: zeros slide in after it, one per column to its right (۳ → ۳۰), then fade

stages.source_note: card transfer: a number on a shipment label, the value of a marked digit. Textbook p.33: «۴۰۳۰ یعنی ۴ هزارتایی و ۳ ده‌تایی» (the ۳ is worth ۳۰; ۳۰۰ = the mirror column, PV-M02; ۳ = face value, PV-M01) and «۵+۲۰۰+۸۰۰۰=۸۲۰۵» (the ۲ is worth ۲۰۰; ۲۰ = mirror, ۲ = face).
